title: An abstract research field

design.question: For the same money, does OSO get further than traditional research in an abstract research field?
design.compare: the six rule settings, an α sweep, the parameters one by one, costly and fallible sharing
design.fixed: the field, 12 agents and a budget of 1200

answer: OSO ahead: level 7.9 against 5.7 of 8; targets 6.9 against 4.2 of 7; ROI 1.44 against 0.22.
caveats: A simulation with guessed parameters: it shows how the rules play out if the field works as described.
OSO's lead as the market-set parameters vary: 0.3 to 1.9 levels.
superseded: Earlier version (before 2026-10-24): a hand-written graph where every parent is required. The topic is now a preset of the idea graph generator; see its current report.
